source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, this is looking great! I have a couple of things. I think I found a glitch with the gallery. I've recorded a clip as follows. Could we also make the mobile version have no hover animations? I think it can be a bit jarring when the only way to hover is by touching the screen. Bonus points if we can reformat the mobile version of the pricing sheet so you don't have to scroll right to see all the info. I understand if that is too late to do, as we have already started implementing the site. Finally, can we have the buttons on the home screen direct to their corresponding pages (gallery, pricing, services)? Right now, it seems they just direct back to the top of the home page.

value_updates.mobile_layout_goal: show all pricing information without requiring horizontal scrolling

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Hello Jordan,

We're aware of the gallery glitch. At the moment, the gallery is using placeholder images, and we're waiting for the final images from you. We'd prefer to replace those first and then address the glitch, as fixing it now may result in the same issue occurring again once the images are swapped.

We'll also remove the hover animations on mobile devices. We agree that hover effects don't provide the best experience on touch screens.

Regarding the pricing table, our recommendation is to keep the horizontal scroll on smaller screens. Since there are several columns, it's the most practical way to ensure all of the information remains readable on mobile devices. An alternative approach would be to keep the first column fixed while allowing the remaining columns to scroll horizontally, similar to how it's implemented here on mobile: <https://hartcore.live/plans/>. Let us know which approach you prefer or if you have something else in mind.

We'll also update the homepage buttons so they link directly to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages as requested.

We'll get started on these changes and get back to you with an update. In the meantime, we look forward to hearing your preference for the pricing table approach so we can implement the option that works best for you.

Thank you! 🙂

ambiguity.description: The client requested a no-horizontal-scroll mobile layout, while the agency recommended retaining horizontal scrolling and offered a fixed-first-column alternative, leaving the layout approach pending client selection.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Sounds good. The animations are great; we can keep them. For now, the pricing approach is good. I will brainstorm it and update you if anything changes. Also, how many photos will I need to send you to get the gallery set up properly? I am pulling from my portfolio now.

value_updates.mobile_layout_approach: retain the current horizontal-scrolling pricing table for now
